summary: An ARIA menu surface: one tab stop, arrow keys, typeahead, and optional single or multiple selection. Children are MenuItem and MenuSection. What opens it, and where it sits, is the caller's.
useWhen: a list of actions or choices for the thing the user is on — row actions, a workspace switcher, a sort order
the rows need icons, a selected check, or grouping under headings — more than a native <select> can hold

useInstead.when: one value is picked for a form field from a modest list of plain text options
useInstead.why: a form value is a listbox, not a menu; the native picker brings type-ahead and the mobile platform picker for free

useInstead.when: the user types to narrow a long list down to one value
it is primary navigation rather than a list of actions
useInstead.why: a menu's rows are actions; links to pages belong in the document's navigation, where a screen reader's landmarks find them

useInstead.when: any action or page should be reachable by searching

composition.note: MenuItem and MenuSection are collection elements: Menu reads them from its DIRECT children to build the collection, and neither renders anything itself. Every MenuItem needs a `key`, and `onAction`, `selectedKeys` and `disabledKeys` all speak in those keys. Menu does not open, close or position itself — put it in a Popover until MenuTrigger exists.
composition.example: <Menu aria-label="Row actions" onAction={(key) => run(key)}><MenuSection title="Edit"><MenuItem key="rename" icon={<Icon as={Pencil} />}>Rename</MenuItem><MenuItem key="duplicate">Duplicate</MenuItem></MenuSection><MenuSection aria-label="Danger"><MenuItem key="archive" isDisabled>Archive</MenuItem></MenuSection></Menu>

none.use: the default — a list of actions. Rows are `menuitem`, and there is no check slot

single.use: Figma's Type=Single — one current choice, such as a sort order or the active workspace. Rows are `menuitemradio`

multiple.use: Figma's Type=Multi — independent toggles, such as visible columns. Rows are `menuitemcheckbox`

guarantees: one tab stop; arrow keys move between rows, Home and End jump, and typing a letter moves to the next row starting with it
disabled rows are listed and announced as unavailable, and the arrow keys skip them
with a selection mode, rows are `menuitemradio` or `menuitemcheckbox` and announce `aria-checked` — the check glyph is never the only signal
the pointer and the keyboard share one highlighted row: hovering a row focuses it
requires: an accessible name — `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` naming what the actions are for
notes: A menu is not a form control. It has no `name` and submits nothing; `selectedKeys` is state you hold.
Titled sections are named groups. An untitled section needs `aria-label`, and is set off by a rule.

antiPatterns.dont: wrapping MenuItems in a <div>, a fragment or your own component inside Menu
antiPatterns.why: Menu reads its collection from its direct children; a wrapped row is invisible to it and renders nothing
MenuItem renders nothing, so there is no element to click. Pass `onAction` to Menu; it receives the item's key, from the pointer, Enter and Space alike

antiPatterns.dont: using Menu for a form field's value
antiPatterns.why: a screen reader announces a menu as actions, and a form cannot read it. Use Select or Combobox

antiPatterns.dont: putting links to other pages in a Menu
antiPatterns.why: they vanish from the page's link list and landmarks. Navigation belongs in NavItem or Sidebar
